description:
"Lash out with a flaming chain, pulling an enemy to you. The searing metal deals |cffffff4846|r Flame Damage, applies the Burning status effect, and taunts them for |cffffff15|r seconds if they are not already taunted.

This attack cannot be dodged or reflected.

Also inflicts Major Cowardice on the enemy, reducing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r for |cffffff10|r seconds."
